stories.title: AJIO launches astronaut-led Diwali campaign
stories.summary: AJIO has launched a Diwali campaign featuring an astronaut who unlocks deals while orbiting the Earth. Conceptualized by 22feet, the campaign focuses on the theme of homecoming. Consumers are invited to track the mystery astronaut to access exclusive shopping rewards as he circles the planet.

stories.title: Apple releases Diwali film shot on iPhone 18 Pro
stories.summary: Apple collaborated with fashion brand Raw Mango for a Diwali campaign titled Step Into the Light. Directed by Sanjay Garg and shot on the iPhone 18 Pro, the film features traditional dance and textiles. It aims to celebrate the festival without explicitly asking viewers to buy hardware.

stories.title: Swiggy rebrands as Sweety for Diwali
stories.summary: Swiggy has temporarily rebranded as Sweety to celebrate the demand for traditional sweets. The change covers delivery partner jerseys, bags, and social media assets. The company is also running outdoor hoardings featuring the tagline Sweety Sweety Sweety Mujhe Log Bolein across various Indian cities.

stories.title: Somany Bathware targets flushing noise
stories.summary: Somany Bathware is promoting its Quiet Swirl Wall Hung range by highlighting the sound of a toilet flush. The company suggests that flushing noise is an overlooked aspect of bathroom comfort. It is now positioning silence as a feature in its latest marketing effort.

stories.title: Malabar Gold & Diamonds features Alia Bhatt
stories.summary: Malabar Gold & Diamonds has launched a new campaign titled Diamonds That Move With You. The retail brand features actor Alia Bhatt in its latest promotional materials. The full details of the campaign are available for subscribers of The Retail Jeweller India.

stories.title: Kareena Kapoor Khan fronts Malabar Gold campaign
stories.summary: Brand ambassador Kareena Kapoor Khan is featured in a new television commercial for Malabar Gold & Diamonds. The campaign promotes the Nuwa collection. Further information regarding the advertisement is available for subscribers of The Retail Jeweller India.

stories.title: Medusa Beverages launches Bollywood-inspired series
stories.summary: Medusa Beverages has released a three-part video series titled The Great Indian Filmy Diwali. The campaign uses Bollywood references and comedy to depict a bachelor apartment party. The brand aims to connect with younger audiences by encouraging them to make their celebrations fully filmy.

stories.title: Hershey’s India uses AI for Diwali campaign
stories.summary: Hershey’s India has launched an AI-generated campaign for Hershey’s Kisses. Developed by TBWA\Lintas, the digital film depicts a couple struggling to find private moments during family gatherings. It extends the brand platform of Giving Kisses Is Hard into the festive season.

stories.title: The Singleton Social names Shruti Haasan brand face
stories.summary: The Singleton Social has appointed actor and singer Shruti Haasan as its new face. The announcement accompanies a festive collaboration with lifestyle brand Nicobar, featuring three gift boxes. The platform continues to organize experiences focused on music, art, and social gatherings.

stories.title: Kurlon promotes sleep in festive campaign
stories.summary: Kurlon has launched a digital campaign featuring actor Sidharth to encourage consumers to prioritize sleep. Part of the Upgrade What Matters proposition, the campaign suggests that mattresses are an overlooked component of festive home improvements. The brand is focusing on everyday comfort over traditional decorations.

stories.title: Apple and Raw Mango film captures Diwali
stories.summary: Apple released a Diwali campaign titled Step Into the Light, featuring actor Juhi Chawla. Shot on the iPhone 18 Pro at Tijara Fort, the film uses choreography and traditional textiles to depict the festival. It is set to a folk interpretation of a 1990s song.

stories.title: ENVY Perfumes launches campaign with Kapoor and Dhawan
stories.summary: ENVY Perfumes has launched a campaign titled Nice Perfume featuring actors Janhvi Kapoor and Varun Dhawan. The narrative focuses on fragrance as a conversation starter during an unexpected encounter. The brand intends to use the partnership to expand its Eau de Parfum portfolio.

stories.title: UFO Moviez launches campaign for Ramayana
stories.summary: UFO Moviez has introduced a campaign called Blessings to invite brands to participate in the theatrical rollout of Ramayana: Part 1. The platform offers access to over 4,000 screens across India. The campaign aims to connect brands with audiences during the cinematic event.

stories.title: GTF Technologies wins agency award
stories.summary: GTF Technologies has been named Agency of the Year at the Realty Conclave & Excellence Awards 2026 North. The Noida-based firm was recognized for its work in real estate branding and marketing. The award acknowledges the agency's role in building brands within the sector.

stories.title: Kamal Haasan reflects on brand endorsements
stories.summary: Actor Kamal Haasan celebrated his 72nd birthday by reflecting on his five-decade career. Haasan historically maintained a strict boundary between his artistic work and commercial advertising. He began engaging in brand endorsements in 2015, ending a long period of professional scarcity.

stories.title: Weekly roundup of advertising campaigns
stories.summary: Recent advertising campaigns have utilized diverse storytelling techniques to enhance product visibility. Notable examples include Skipper Pipes personifying household seepage and Pirelli paying tribute to photographer Raghu Rai. Brands are increasingly using humor and emotional narratives to connect with consumers this season.

stories.title: Brands shift Diwali advertising narratives
stories.summary: Diwali 2026 advertising has moved away from traditional gifting themes toward childhood memories and relationships. Amazon India and Zomato are among the brands using storytelling to highlight everyday festive moments. Advertisers are finding new ways to frame familiar cultural narratives for current audiences.

stories.title: Brands focus on emotional storytelling
stories.summary: Advertising this week has emphasized human emotions and cultural observations over conventional product-led communication. Brands including Royal Stag, Hershey’s India, and Taj Mahal Tea are using nostalgia and identity to build connections. The industry continues to turn everyday moments into brand stories.

stories.title: Publicis and WPP trade barbs over agency pitches
stories.summary: Publicis Groupe publicly disputed WPP CEO Cindy Rose's comments regarding pitchless agency appointments. In an open letter, Publicis criticized WPP for skipping the Coca-Cola North American media review and defended its own account wins as the result of thorough evaluations rather than CEO relationships.

stories.title: Microdrama advertising market eyes rapid growth
stories.summary: India's microdrama advertising market is projected to grow from 24 crore in FY26 to 210 crore in FY27. While subscriptions currently account for 99 percent of revenue, industry estimates suggest advertising could reach 5,500 crore by FY32 as the format develops more sustainable commercial models.

stories.title: Shah Rukh Khan remains a staple for brand endorsements
stories.summary: Shah Rukh Khan continues to command significant attention in advertising nearly four decades into his career. Despite an increasingly fragmented market, brands including Hyundai, Vi, and Visa maintain partnerships with the actor, citing the value of his enduring familiarity and reach with consumers.

stories.title: Omnicom Media Group leads RECMA agency rankings
stories.summary: Omnicom Media India has been ranked number one among media agency groups in the latest RECMA Network Diagnostics Report. The network also retained its position as the top-performing global media group for the second consecutive report, with three of its agencies ranking among the country's highest.

The move places the Meta-owned platform in direct competition with YouTube for podcasts and interviews. The platform is currently rolling out the tool to select creators in the US.

stories.title: Mark Rober balances AI tools with human production
stories.summary: Science YouTuber Mark Rober says his content is protected from AI-generated slop by its focus on real-world experiments. While he believes his work has a moat, his team uses generative AI as a thought partner for writing and developing educational modules for students.

stories.title: Fitness influencer reports gym membership cancellation
stories.summary: A fitness creator known as @bwrlifts claims his gym membership was cancelled after he filmed a workout video. The creator suggests the gym owner took issue with his science-based approach to weightlifting after he stood on a machine seat to adjust his range of motion.

stories.title: Mark Rober on fighting AI content with reality
stories.summary: YouTuber Mark Rober suggests creators can combat the rise of AI-generated content by focusing on real-world demonstrations. While he notes that AI tools can assist with editing and language dubbing, he argues that the knowledge of a stunt being real is what provides value.

stories.summary: Instagram is rolling out two new features aimed at longer-form content. The first is “Features,” a horizontal video format that supports uploads of up to 90 minutes, designed for podcasters, comedians, and extended storytelling. stories.title: YouTube deletes 400 channels amid advertiser exodus
stories.summary: YouTube has banned more than 400 channels and disabled comments on millions of videos following a controversy regarding child exploitation on the platform. Major brands including Disney, AT&T, Nestle and Fortnite have halted advertising in response. The platform is currently in crisis mode again.

stories.title: YouTube launches Premium Lite in Vietnam
stories.summary: YouTube is rolling out Premium Lite in Vietnam, priced at VND49,000 per month via web or VND65,000 through the app. The plan allows offline viewing and background play, though it does not remove ads from all content. Users may still encounter advertising while watching certain types of videos.

stories.title: Rhode Island sues Meta over fraudulent ads
stories.summary: Rhode Island is suing Meta for allegedly helping to create and optimize fraudulent advertisements. Attorney General Peter Neronha claims the company represents that it aggressively combats scams while knowingly distributing large volumes of deceptive ads to users. Meta claims it detects, prevents and removes such content.

stories.title: YouTube expands paid hype feature to nine markets
stories.summary: YouTube has extended its paid hype feature to nine additional markets, allowing viewers to spend Jewels to boost videos. Creators earn Rubies, a virtual currency paid out through AdSense, from the points. The feature is limited to partners with between 500 and 500,000 subscribers.

stories.title: Meta defends anti-scam efforts as Poland pushes for fine
stories.summary: Meta is facing pressure from Polish authorities over fraudulent ads. Nathaniel Gleicher, the company's head of security policy, stated that Meta removed 3.7 million accounts in a recent operation targeting organized crime groups. The company maintains that artificial intelligence is helping it fight these sophisticated networks.

stories.title: Instagram tests 90-minute video uploads
stories.summary: Instagram is testing a feature allowing creators to upload videos up to 90 minutes long. The tool is designed for podcasters and comedians to keep users on the platform longer. The test is currently limited to a small group of creators in the United States and Brazil.

stories.title: Amazon shopping agent adds text orders and ads
stories.summary: Amazon is introducing a text-based shopping agent that includes Sponsored Product ads within the conversation threads. Purchases completed by the agent independently remain ad-free. The feature is currently available to a small, invite-only group of U.S. customers, with plans to expand in the coming weeks.

stories.title: AppLovin reports growth following AI pivot
stories.summary: After Apple tightened tracking rules in 2021, AppLovin saw its stock plunge 89 percent. The company spent $7 billion on share buybacks and rebuilt its advertising technology around artificial intelligence. By early November 2026, the company reached a valuation of more than $119 billion.

stories.summary: First Insight has launched an MCP Server to integrate consumer insights into AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. The company claims retailers can now assort and price products in days. The tool aims to move beyond historical sales data by incorporating the voice of real shoppers.

stories.title: firmly secures $15 million for agentic commerce
stories.summary: The no-code platform firmly has raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Squarepoint Capital. The company also launched Ask Agent, a conversational shopping tool for merchant websites. Strategic investors include J.P. Morgan Payments, Mastercard and Samsung NEXT.

stories.title: Adobe predicts AI traffic surge as Google launches Universal Cart
stories.summary: Adobe projects AI traffic to U.S. retail sites will rise 130 percent this holiday season. Meanwhile, Google launched Universal Cart on Oct. 15, using over 60 billion product listings to facilitate checkout. The holiday season is now officially a data processing event.

stories.title: MerchantFloor releases AI agent for Shopify listings
stories.summary: MerchantFloor launched a Product Listing Agent designed to convert photos and notes into Shopify listings in under five minutes. The tool targets small store owners managing photography, SEO and copywriting. It aims to automate the tasks that usually take more than uploading a photo.
